m: अभि-मान m. intention to injure, insidiousness, KātyŚr.
high opinion of one's self, self-conceit, pride, haughtiness
(in Sāṃkhya phil.) = अभि-मति, above
conception (especially an erroneous one regarding one's self), Sāh. &c.
affection, desire
N. of a Ṛṣi in the sixth Manvantara, VP.
अभि-मान See अभि-√ मन्.
a: अभिमानः — 1 Pride(in a good sense), self-respect, honourable or worthy feeling; सदाभिमानैकधना हि मानिनः Śi. 1. 67; Bh. 3. 5; अभिमानधनस्य गत्वरैः Ki. 2. 19; संकल्पयोनेरभिमानभूतं Ku. 3. 24. --2 Self-conceit, pride, arrogance, haughtiness, egotism, high-opinion of oneself; शिथिल˚नाः संवृत्ताः M. 2, Bh. 3. 46, Bg. 16. 4; ˚वत् proud, conceited. --3 Referring all objects to self, the act of अहंकार, personality, misconception (मिथ्याज्ञानं), see अहंकार. --4 Conceit, conception; supposition, belief, opinion; Ki. 13. 7. --5 Knowledge, consciousness (बुद्धि, ज्ञान); साधारण्याभिमानतः S. D. --6 Affection, love. --7 Desire, wishing for. --8 Laying claim to. --9 Injury, killing, seeking to injure. --10 A sort of state occasioned by love. --Comp. --शालिन् a. proud --शून्य a. void of pride or arrogance, humble.

k.v: गर्वोऽभिमानोऽहङ्कारो मानश्चित्तसमुन्नतिः। दर्पोऽवलोकोऽवष्टम्भश्चित्तोद्रेकः स्मयो मदः। अनादरः परिभवः परीभावस्तिरस्क्रिया॥
शक्रो घातुकमत्तेभो वर्षुकाब्दो घनाघनः। अभिमानोऽर्थादिदर्पे ज्ञाने प्रणयहिंसयोः।
शक्रो घातुकमत्तेभो वर्षुकाब्दो घनाघनः। अभिमानोऽर्थादिदर्पे ज्ञाने प्रणयहिंसयोः।

m: अभि-मान—शालिन् mfn. proud, arrogant, Kir. ii, 48.
अभि-मान—शून्य mfn. void of conceit, humble.
अभि-मान—ता f. pride, arrogance.
अभि-मान—वत् mfn. conceiving or having ideas about self
proud, arrogant.

v: aBimAnin

tri॰ aBi + mana--Rini striyAM NIp । 1 garvayukte 2 praRayakopAdiyukte ca sotyasya manoH 3 putraBede pu॰ । “taraNgaBIrurvapraSca tarasvAnugra eva ca aBimAnI pravIRaSca jizRuH saMkrandanastaTA । tejasvI sabalaScEva sOtyasyEte manoH sutAH, ha॰ vaM॰ । 4 miTyAjYAnayukte tri॰ । “aBimAnivyapadeSastu viSezAnugatiByAm” SA॰ sU॰ । “yatoBimAnivyapadeSa ezaH । mfdAdyaBimAninyovAgAdyaBimAninyaScetanA devatA vadanasaMvadanAdizu cetanocitezu vyavahArezu vyapadiSyante” SA॰ BA॰ ।
m: अभि-मानिन् mfn. thinking of one's self, proud, self-conceited
(ifc.) imagining one's self to be or to possess, laying claim to, arrogating to one's self
अभि-मानिन् m. N. of an Agni, VP.; BhP.
a: अभिमानिन् — a. 1 Possessed of selfrespect; Ki. 1. 31; K. 212. --2 Having a high opinion of oneself, proud, arrogant, conceited. --3 Regarding all objects as referring to one's own self; अभिमानिव्यपदेशस्तु विशेषानुगतिभ्यां Br. Sūt. --4 Fancying, pretending, or regarding oneself to be; नरेंद्र˚ Dk. 51; K. 194. --m. A form of Agni.

m: अभिमानि-ता, f. or अभिमानि-त्व, n. the state of self-conceitedness.

s: aBimAnitaM
klI, (aBimAnaH jAto'sya, aBimAnaH + itac । aBimAnyate'tra, aBi + man + Ric + ADAre ktaH .) surataM । mETunaM । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥ aBimAnayukte tri ॥ (garvvaH । madaH । darpaH .)

m: अभि-मानित n. copulation, sexual intercourse, L.
a: अभिमानितं — 1 Egotism. --2 Love; copulation, sexual union.

v: aBimAnuka
tri॰ aBi + mana--bA॰ ukaY । aBimAnaSIle aBimAnaSca prAguktaH bADitu Sakte ca । “anaktA evasyuraBimAnukorudraH paSUntsyAt yadaYjyAt” Sata॰ brA॰ । “aBimantuMbADituM SaktaH syAt” BA॰ ।
m: अभि-मानुक mfn. insidious (with acc.), ŚBr. (cf. अन्-अभिमानुक.)
a: अभिमानुक — a. Ved. [मन् वाहु˚ उकच्] Striving to hurt or injure.

m: अभि-मार्गणा f. tracking, searching out, Jātakam.
अभि-मारुतम् ind. against the wind.

अभि-माति f. striving to injure, RV.
an enemy, foe, RV.; AV.; ŚBr.
अभि-माति See अभि-√ मन्.
a: अभिमाति — a. [मे कर्तरि क्तिन् न इत्त्वं] Striving or seeking to injure, inimical. --तिः f. 1 Seeking to injure, hurting, plotting against. --2 An enemy, a foe.

m: अभि-माति—हन् mfn. striking or destroying one's enemies, RV.; VS.
अभि-माति—जित् mfn. subduing the enemies, VS.

pu॰ aBimAtamanena aBi + meNa--BAve kta vede pf॰ na ittvam izwA॰ in । SatrO । “bADate viSvamaBimAtinam” f॰ 1, 85, 3 “aBimAtinam Satrum” BA॰ ।

a: अभिमातिन् — a. [मे-क्त, इष्टादिभ्यः इन्] One who hurts or injures, an enemy.

m: अभि-माति—षाह्य (7) n. conquering enemies, RV. iii, 37, 3.

excited, stirred up (as by passions), MBh. i, 7794.
a: अभिमूर्छित — a. Utterly confused, bewildered.
{{अभिमंथ->अभिमंथः||20170131||ह्त्त्प्स्:गित्हुब्.चोम्सन्स्क्रित्-लेऌइचोन्छौण्णैछ्थीऔङ्शिस्सुएस्335|दुए तो रेऋ. तो ह्ट् अद्हिमṁत्हḥ}} — = अधिमंथः q. v.
अभिमंतृ — a. Longing for; self-conceited, referring all objects to self; Ms. 1. 14.

अभिमंत्र् — {c10c} A. (P. also) 1 To consecrate or accompany with sacred hymns; पशुरसौ योऽभिमंत्र्य क्रतौ हतः Ak.; वामदेवाभिमंत्रितोऽश्वः U. 2; Y. 3. 326; 2. 102; 3. 278. --2 To consecrate with magical formulas, charm, enchant, invoke or invite by means of charms; तदभिमंत्रितेन चरणेन Dk. 138; पानीयैरभिमंत्रितैः Mb. --3 To speak to, address, invite.

अभिमंत्रणं — 1 Consecrating, hallowing, making sacred by repetition of special formulas or Mantras; Y. 1. 237; मंत्रमुच्चारयन्नेव मंत्रार्थत्वेन संस्मरेत् . शेषिणं तन्मना भूत्वा स्यादेतदभिमंत्रणम् .. Mīmāmsā. --2 Charming, enchanting. --3 Addressing, inviting; advising.
अभिमंतुः — f. Ved. Injuring, harming, destroying; ˚तोः to destroy; to claim as ones' own, pretending.

m: अभि-मङ्गल mfn. auspicious, PārGṛ.
अभि-√ मद् (p. -माद्यत्) to be inebriated, ŚBr. (cf. अभि- √ 1. मन्द् below.)
a: अभिमद् — {c4c} P. Ved. To gladden, exhilarate, inebriate.

m: अभि-√ मन् -मन्यते (Subj. -मन्याते, RV. x, 27, 11) to think of, long for, desire, RV. &c.; (aor. Subj. 2. sg. -मंस्थाः, 3. sg. -मंस्त, Ved. Inf. अभि-मन्तोः, ŚBr.) to intend to injure, be insidious, threaten, injure, VS.; AV. &c.; to kill, AitBr. (aor. -अमंस्त), KātyŚr.; to allow, agree, MBh. ii, 1374, &c.; to think of self, be proud of; to think, suppose, imagine, take for (acc.)
a: अभिमन् — {c4c} A. (P. epic) 1 To wish or desire, long for, covet, like; न त्वेवं ज्यायसीं वृत्तिमभिमन्येत कर्हिचित् Ms. 10. 95; see अभिमत below. --2 To assent to, approve of, allow, admit; give a grant (to any one, dat.). --3 To think, fancy, imagine, consider, believe, regard; तामार्यामसावन्यथाऽभ्यमन्यत Dk. 164; Bk. 5. 71, U. 5. --4 To injure, threaten (Ved.) --5 ({c8c} A.) To think of self.

m: अभि-मनाय Nom. Ā. (Opt. -मनायेत) to long for, desire, Bhaṭṭ. (cf. g. भृशादि) : Desid. -मिमानयिषते, Pat.
Nom. (also) to recover consciousness or calmness, Daś.

a: अभिमनायते — Den. A. To have life, be full of life and joy, be pleased or delighted, to long for; अभ्यमनायिष्ट चांतरात्मा Dk. 111, 119; कांतिं ( विलोक्य) नाभिमनायेत को वा स्थाणुसमोपि ते Bk. 5. 73 (Com. = सचेताः or प्रीतमनाः).

m: अभि-√ मन्थ् to churn or rub (for eliciting fire), ŚBr. xiv.

अभि-√ 1. मन्द् P. (3. pl. aor. -अमन्दिषुः) to gladden, RV. viii, 50, 3; Ā. (2. sg. -मन्दसे) to be pleased with, enjoy (with loc.), RV. x, 50, 2 (cf. अभि-√ मद् above.)

m: अभि-मन्यु m. N. of a son of Manu Cākṣuṣa
of a son of Arjuna (by Subhadrā)
of two kings of Kāśmīra, Rājat.
a: अभिमन्युः — N. of a son of Arjuna by his wife Subhadrā, sister of Kṛṣṇa and Balarāma; also known by the metronymic Saubhadra. [He was called Abhimanyu because at his very birth he appeared to be heroic, longarmed and very fiery (अभिवृद्धः मन्युर्यस्य). When the Kauravas at the advice of Droṇa formed the peculiar battlearray called ‘Chakravyūha,’ hoping that, as Arjuna was away, none of the Pāṇḍavas would be able to break through it, Abhimanyu assured his uncles that he was ready to try, if they only assisted him. He accordingly entered the Vyūha, killed many warriors on the Kaurava side, and was for a time more than a match even for such veteran and elderly heroes as Droṇa, Karṇa, Duryodhana &c. He could not, however, hold out long against fearful odds, and was at last overpowered and slain. He was very handsome. He had two wives, Vatsalā daughter of Balarāma and Uttarā daughter of the king of Virāṭa. Uttarā was pregnant when he was slain and gave birth to a son named Parīkṣita who succeeded to the throne of Hastināpura].

a: अभिमुख — a. (खी f.) [अभिगतं मुखं यस्य P. VI. 2. 185] 1 With the face turned or directed towards, in the direction of, towards, turned towards, facing; अभिमुखे मयि संहृतमीक्षितं Ś. 2. 11; ˚खा शाला Sk.; गच्छन्नभिमुखो वह्नौ नाशं याति पतंगवत् Pt. 1. 237; with the acc.; राजानमेवाभिमुखा निषेदुः; पंपामभिमुखो यंयौ Rām.; Bg. 11. 28; K. 264; sometimes with dat., or gen. or loc.; आश्रमायाभिमुखा बभूवुः Mb.; यस्ते तिष्ठेदभिमुखे रणे Rām.; मय्यभिमुखीभूय Dk. 124; also in comp.; शकुंतलाभिमुखो भूत्वा Ś. 1 turning towards Ś.; Ku. 3. 75, 7. 9. --2 Coming or going near, approaching, near or close at hand; अभिमुखीष्विव वांछितसिद्धिषु व्रजति निर्वृतिमेकपदे मनः V. 2. 9; यौवनाभिमुखी संजज्ञे Pt. 4; R. 17. 40. --3 Disposed or intending to, inclined to; ready for, about (to do something), in comp.; चंद्रापीडाभिमुखहृदया K. 198, 233; अस्ताभिमुखे सूर्ये Mu. 4. 19; प्रसादाभिमुखो वेधाः प्रत्युवाच दिवौकसः Ku. 2. 16; 5. 60; U. 7. 4, Māl. 10. 13; कर्मण्यभिमुखेन स्थेयं Dk. 89; अनभिमुखः सुखानां K. 45; प्रातः प्रयाणाभिमुखाय तस्मै R. 5. 29; निद्रा चिरेण नयनाभिसुखी बभूव 5. 64; sometimes as first member of comp. in this sense; फलमभिमुखपाकं राजजंबूद्रुमस्य V. 4. 13. --4 Favourable, friendly or favourably disposed; आनीय झटिति घटयति विधिरभिमतमभिमुखीभूतः Ratn. 1. 7. --5 Taking one's part, nearly related to. --6 With the face turned upwards. --खी One of the 10 earths according to Buddhists. --खं, --खे ind. Towards, in the direction of, facing, in front or presence of, near to; with acc., gen. or in comp., or by itself; ये गताभिमुखं विष्णुं Rām.; आसीताभिमुखं गुरोः Ms. 2. 193; तिष्ठन्मुनेरभिमुखं स विकीर्णधाम्नः Ki. 2. 59; Śi. 13. 2; Ki. 6. 46; नेपथ्याभिमुखमवलोक्य Ś. 1; स पुराभिमुखं प्रतस्थे Pt. 3; Me. 68; कर्णं ददात्यभिमुखं मयि भाषमाणे Ś. 1. 31; also at the beginning of comp.; अभिमुखनिहतस्य Bh. 2. 112 killed in the front ranks of battle.

m: अभि-मुखम् ind. towards (often used in a hostile manner, Kir. vi, 14, &c.), in the direction of, in front or presence of, near to (acc. gen.; or ifc.)
अभि-मुख—ता f. presence, proximity.
a: अभिमुखता — 1 Presence, proximity. --2 Favourableness; ˚तां नी to win over Ki. 10. 40.

m: अभिमुखय Nom. P. ˚यति, to face, Kir. xii, 19.
Nom. (also) to conciliate(?), Kir.
अभि-मुखे ind. in front or presence of (gen.; or ifc.), R.
अभि-√ मुच् P. -मुञ्चति, to let go, let loose, MBh. xii, 10949 : Ā. to throw or shoot (as arrows), MBh. vii, 3967.
अभि-√ मुह् to lose consciousness, faint away, Suśr.
अभि-मुनि ind. before the eyes of the Muni, ib.
